instruction: Candid outdoor medium shot of a couple on a snowy wooden bridge in a winter forest. On the left, the man in the black parka (R1) walks forward, looking warmly at his partner. On the right, the woman in the brown jacket (R2) walks beside him, smiling gently. They hold hands as they walk. Soft, diffused daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the cool winter tones.
